t: Forge Steel 20-piece metric tap and die set is engineered for the repair of external and internal screw threads. The versatile thread repair kit is ideal for automotive mechanics, engineers, and metalworkers, to ensure accurate thread restoration in various workshop and site applications. Constructed from durable high carbon steel, the taps and dies offer rust resistance and long life, making them suitable for demanding tasks. The set includes 18 essential metric sizes, ranging from M3 to M12, complete with sturdy tap and die handles. Supplied in a protective plastic carry case for convenient organisation, storage and transport. Not suitable for cutting new threads.
